target.name: Heat, residential, by transfer of geothermal heat using ground source heat pump using electricity from grid

strategy.label: transcription drafted from the report excerpt by the LLM pipeline (reverse-bafu draft)
strategy.note: basis: No inventory table for this dataset exists in the excerpt; Tab. 83 'Main specifications for the reference technologies for heating' (p.131) is a specification table for OTHER technologies. Basis taken as 1 MJ of heat delivered.; allocation: none stated. Review every derivation; unreviewed entries have reviewed_by = null.

evidence.source: 2024 - LCA power-to-X in residential sector - Sacchi.pdf

gaps_reported_by_model: The excerpt documents no ground-source heat pump: Tab. 83's heat-pump rows are air-water units at 440 % (CoP ~4.4), not a ground-source unit at 390 %.
No heat pump infrastructure (the 10 kW unit, 20 a lifetime, 2100 h/a stated in the metadata) can be read from the excerpt.
No borehole heat exchanger / ground loop input.
No refrigerant charge and no refrigerant leakage emission.
No grid loss handling beyond the 0.06 % stated in metadata.
The excerpt gives only impact-result figures (Figure 60, Figure 61) for the Power-to-X chains, which are results, not inventory.

inputs.name: Electricity, low voltage, at grid
inputs.note: The report excerpt does NOT document this dataset. Table 83 lists only reference heating technologies - an AIR-water heat pump at 440 % (CoP ~4.4), a wood-chip furnace, a biomethane boiler and a natural gas boiler - none of them a ground-source heat pump. The electricity draw is therefore derived from the 390 % efficiency stated in the dataset's own metadata, not read out of the report.

derivation.quote: - generalComment: This dataset represents the supply of 1 megajoule of heat in a residence, by transfer of geothermal heat in a ground source heat pump.  The electricity is from grid. Heat conversion efficiency [% LHV input]: 390%.
derivation.factor_source: 1 / 3.90 = 0.2564 MJ electricity per MJ heat, from the stated heat conversion efficiency of 390 %
derivation.mapping_reason: The dataset says 'The electricity is from grid' without naming an import route, so the Swiss low-voltage supply mix is the right draw; the import-XX and production-CH variants are specific routes.
